prompt:
## Objective
Give run-once a repair turn on post-turn gate failure. Today `run_gates_for_phase` returning {:error, ...} (agent_runner.ex L1044/L1056) short-circuits the turn loop and fails the whole run even with 17 turns of budget left; the agent never sees the gate output.

## Design summary
- On post-turn gate failure with turn budget remaining: build a continuation prompt containing the failed gate names and the tail (last ~100 lines each) of the failing gate logs, and feed it to the agent as the next turn at the SAME tier.
- Bound: @max_gate_repair_attempts 2 per run (module attribute, no new config surface). Abort with the existing gate_failed error when attempts or turn budget are exhausted.
- Environment-class failures: if an existing failure classification distinguishes environment errors from code errors, only code-class failures get repair turns. If no such classification exists (probe first), treat all gate failures as repairable and say so explicitly in the final report - do not invent a taxonomy.
- This matches the settled envelope policy: code failures get a same-tier repair loop (cf. RON-146 clean-eval proofs).
- Tests: gate failure -> repair turn issued with gate output in prompt -> gate passes -> run continues; two failures -> abort with gate_failed; budget exhausted -> abort.

## File scope
Include: elixir/lib/rondo/agent_runner.ex plus tests. Exclude: orchestrator-mode retries, gate selection, run-decision/terminal-outcome logic (RON-161 handles that; it depends on this slice).

## Constraints
Same-tier only - never escalate tier in the repair loop. No remote writes.

## Verification

Pre-PR: cd elixir && mix dialyzer --format short
